inputs.name: role
inputs.description: What the hosts run: "server" for the auth and proxy services on one host, or "node" for SSH nodes that join a server through its proxy.

inputs.name: teleport_version
inputs.description: Teleport Community Edition release to install from Teleport's repository, such as "18.11.8". Its major version picks the repository channel, stable/v18.

inputs.name: public_addr
inputs.description: Server only, required there: the name and port users and nodes reach the proxy on, such as "teleport.example.com:443". The certificate has to cover the name.

inputs.name: web_listen_address
inputs.description: Server only, required there: the address and port the proxy listens on, such as "192.168.1.40:443". Users, nodes and the auth service all come in through this one port.

inputs.name: cluster_name
inputs.description: Server only: the cluster's name, which can't change once the server has started. When null, the name in public_addr.

inputs.name: https_cert_file
inputs.description: Server only: path on the host to the proxy's certificate chain, in PEM, for the name in public_addr. When null, Teleport makes a self-signed one, which nodes won't join through.

inputs.name: https_key_file
inputs.description: Server only: path on the host to the key for https_cert_file.

inputs.name: proxy_address
inputs.description: Node only, required there: the server's public_addr, such as "teleport.example.com:443". Nodes connect out to it, so they need no open port of their own.

inputs.name: proxy_ca
inputs.description: PEM certificate of a private CA that signed the proxy's certificate, added to each host's trust store so Teleport trusts the proxy. Leave null for a certificate from a public CA.

inputs.name: join
inputs.description: On a server, create join_token as a token nodes join with. On a node, join the server with it. When false, no token is needed.

inputs.name: join_token
inputs.description: The join token, at least 32 letters, digits, _ or -. Pass the same one to the server and its nodes. Required when join is true.

inputs.name: join_token_ttl
inputs.description: Server only: hours the join token works for, counted from when the server creates it. Teleport deletes it after that.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Labels for the SSH service on every host, such as { env = "homelab" }, which Teleport roles can match on.
